description: This file defines a Java class 'InstanceModeSupportExtension' which implements JUnit 5 extension interfaces to manage and reset instance modes for testing in the Apache Fineract project. It handles setup and teardown logic for test environments, configuring instance modes based on method annotations.

classes.name: InstanceModeSupportExtension
classes.description: A JUnit 5 extension class managing setup and teardown of instance modes during tests, utilizing annotations and REST API calls.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured and resets the instance mode before all tests.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Re-initializes REST Assured and resets the instance mode after all tests.

methods.name: beforeTestExecution
methods.description: Configures instance mode based on annotation before each test method execution.

methods.name: afterTestExecution
methods.description: Resets instance mode after each test method execution if annotated.

methods.name: resetInstanceMode
methods.description: Resets the instance mode to default (all enabled).

methods.name: changeInstanceMode
methods.description: Changes the instance mode configuration via REST API calls based on parameters.
